source.raw_extract:
## When to apply

A new batch of selected Erasmus Mundus Masters is added to the list each year.

In most cases, you should submit your application between **October** and **January** for courses starting the following academic year.

Each master's website has all the details about the course of study, the list of the participating universities, the entry requirements and all the steps of the application process (with and without scholarship).
source.exact_deadline_wording: In most cases, you should submit your application between October and January for courses starting the following academic year.
source.notes: The shard's official_source_url (studyinbelgium.be, a Wallonie-Bruxelles Campus agency page) was fetched live and contains NO deadline text whatsoever - the shard's cached display string could not be located there. Following the hierarchy upward, the awarding body's own European Commission Erasmus+ student page states the October-January window verbatim, and the EACEA Erasmus Mundus Catalogue independently corroborates it: "Most master's programmes require applications to be submitted between October and January for courses commencing the following academic year. Interested students should visit the program's official website and directly contact the consortium for information on courses, application procedures, and scholarship availability." Two official Commission sources agree, so this is not CONFLICTING. The window is months only with no day, so MONTH/month is correct and deadline_date is null. This is a framework-level award covering 218 consortia; the Commission explicitly defers to each consortium's own site for the binding date, so no single date is derivable for the record.

source.raw_extract:
## How to apply

You don't need to apply for the scholarship, we've kept it as easy as possible. Just apply to study at Griffith and we will let you know if you have been successful.

### Process

- Apply to study an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program at Griffith University.
- We will assess your application for scholarship eligibility.
- If you are successful we will advise you in your Letter of Offer, in Tuition and other fees - Total program fees.

### Start
Commence study in Trimester 3, 2025 or any trimester in 2026 or 2027

... Scholarship applies to tuition fees only for students commencing in Trimester 3, 2025 or any trimester in 2026 or 2027. Students who defer commencement to 2028 or later are not eligible to receive the scholarship.
source.exact_deadline_wording: You don't need to apply for the scholarship, we've kept it as easy as possible. Just apply to study at Griffith and we will let you know if you have been successful.
source.notes: The live page states NO closing date and NO scholarship application step: the award is assessed automatically as part of the admission application. Confidence is MEDIUM rather than HIGH because the page never uses the words 'rolling' or 'no fixed deadline' - the ROLLING classification rests on the explicit absence of any separate scholarship application or stated closing date plus automatic assessment on enrolment, not on a verbatim 'rolling' declaration. deadline_date is null and no date is invented. Separately, note the eligibility window is finite: commencement is limited to Trimester 3 2025 or any trimester in 2026 or 2027, and deferral to 2028 or later forfeits eligibility. As of the 2026-10-05 retrieval date the 2026 and 2027 options remain open, so the record is genuinely still live. The shard carries verification_status 'needs_review'; this confirms the rolling characterisation but does not address that review flag. The parent scholarship index page was not separately quoted because the scholarship page itself carries the governing terms.
